g.text: J120 is on the PCB. J121 is a sealed shell-mounted connector, joined by a short internal pigtail.

g.desc: Factory transmission wiring -> Ford J1 -> new PCB J120

g.text: -> short internal pigtail -> shell J121 -> cabin cable

g.desc: -> short internal pigtail -> shell J121 -> cabin cable

g.text: J120 cavity n mates to J121 cavity n electrically.

g.desc: J120 cavity n mates to J121 cavity n electrically.

g.text: MicroSquirt cavity numbers DIFFER: use the harness table.

g.desc: MicroSquirt cavity numbers DIFFER: use the harness table.

g.text: J121 is off-board; omit from PCB placement.

g.desc: J121 is off-board; omit from PCB placement.

g.text: The cabin cable carries solenoid CURRENT as well as

g.desc: The cabin cable carries solenoid CURRENT as well as

g.text: sensor signals, power/returns and CAN. It is not a

g.desc: Twist CAN H/L together; route VR speed as a pair.

g.desc: Keep solenoid PWM currents out of sensor-return wiring.

g.desc: Provide strain relief and a sealed cable route.

g.text: Mount the complete MicroSquirt inside the car, with its tuning connector accessible.
